source: POPS, Paraphrased Opinion Prompt Sensitivity dataset (Alhetelah & Ahmad, WASSA 2026, https://aclanthology.org/2026.wassa-1.5/), HF mazew2000/Paraphrased_Opinion_Prompt_Sensitivity_Dataset_POPS, MIT licence. 200 questions x (original + 5 GPT-4o-mini paraphrases, author-reviewed). random.seed(20261029): 10 of 200 groups. wordings[0] is the original.
